reviewedBy: Claude Opus 5.5 (implementing session, self-review; not a cold reviewer)
method: Walked Data and Home in the in-app browser (Chromium, desktop and 375px phone) on this worktree's vite dev server reading production Supabase read-only through a preload that aborts on any write or non-read RPC (0 blocked in 672 outbound calls), with a stand-in owner session. Two states: production as it is (no rejection reasons yet; the new rows read 'Not recorded yet' and no surge is claimed) and a planted health reading carrying the real Oct 2-6 counter totals as the migration would return them (surge leads the status on both pages; the Home link opens Data at #delivery). A third state, a crawler surge with 5 unstored events, was checked by fetching the page text. The walk found and fixed a client crash (a browser module importing a server-only one) and mixed 'refused'/'rejected' wording. Not covered: WebKit, a real sign-in, screen readers, forced colors, large text, and the page after the migration is applied for real.
